evidence_chain_trigger: Input validation failure on user prompt; prompt firewall bypassed by adversarial semantic perturbation.
compliance_impact: Causes immediate non-compliance rating for NIST SI-10 and ISO A.8.28; degrades overall system integrity score by 25%.
recommended_remediation: Deploy NeMo Guardrails with semantic cosine similarity filters, enforce strict JSON schema delimiters, and restrict LLM autonomous tool execution scope.

evidence_chain_trigger: Regex or regex-token match of PII (PAN/Aadhaar/Credit Card) or secret API keys in raw LLM output stream.
compliance_impact: Direct violation of DPDP Act 2023 Section 8 and NIST SC-28; audit status switches to CRITICAL FINDING with immediate financial penalty liability.
recommended_remediation: Implement post-generation Data Loss Prevention (DLP) token filters, scrub PII from RAG chunk indexes, and redact internal keys.

evidence_chain_trigger: Unverified model checkpoint loaded without cryptographic hash verification; vulnerable third-party Python package in dependency tree.
compliance_impact: Fails ISO A.5.19 and NIST IA-5; requires immediate quarantine of inference container.
recommended_remediation: Enforce Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) scanning via Bandit/Pip-audit, verify HuggingFace commit SHA-256 signatures, and sandbox model weights.

evidence_chain_trigger: Unauthorized modification detected in vector knowledge base documents or training dataset checksum mismatch.
compliance_impact: Compromises model evidentiary provenance under NIST AU-10 and ISO A.8.15.
recommended_remediation: Maintain cryptographic hash trees (Merkle roots) for all RAG documents and require dual-custody authorization for knowledge base updates.

evidence_chain_trigger: Raw LLM output executed directly by client browser as HTML/JS or passed unsanitized into SQL/OS shell execution functions.
compliance_impact: Direct violation of NIST SI-10 and OWASP Top 10 A03:Injection; triggers HIGH vulnerability rating.
recommended_remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding (HTML escaping, parameterized queries for SQL tools, and strict AST parsing for code generators).

evidence_chain_trigger: Autonomous agent executes irreversible database DELETE, financial transfer, or external communication without human confirmation.
compliance_impact: Breaches NIST AC-6 least privilege; exposes enterprise to immediate direct operational loss.
recommended_remediation: Implement Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) gates for sensitive actions, restrict tool execution to idempotent read-only APIs, and enforce hard execution step ceilings.

evidence_chain_trigger: Cosine similarity of LLM response with system prompt exceeds 0.85; meta-prompt extraction prompt successful.
compliance_impact: Compromises intellectual property protection controls under ISO A.8.28.
recommended_remediation: Separate system instructions from user conversational history using strict role tags (`role: system` vs `role: user`) and install post-generation similarity suppression filters.

evidence_chain_trigger: Cross-tenant document retrieval detected in RAG query; unencrypted vector store accessible on public network interface.
compliance_impact: Breaches multi-tenant isolation under NIST AC-3 and ISO A.5.15.
recommended_remediation: Partition vector collections by tenant ID with cryptographic token verification, and encrypt vector index files at rest.

evidence_chain_trigger: Factual consistency score between generated response and retrieved context falls below 0.60.
compliance_impact: Exposes organization to legal liability under consumer protection guidelines and DPDP accuracy mandates.
recommended_remediation: Anchor LLM inference to verified RAG ground-truth documents with temperature set to 0.0, and require citations with exact sentence spans.

evidence_chain_trigger: A single IP or user account submits more than 50 requests/min or exceeds token limit thresholds by 300%.
compliance_impact: Threatens service availability SLAs and violates NIST SC-7 boundary monitoring.
recommended_remediation: Implement Token-Bucket rate limiting at the API gateway, set max token length bounds on incoming prompts, and configure automated billing kill-switches.
